label: EP 7
tone: Absurd, escalating, petty. Every beat wilder than the last. The goat is always somehow involved.

claimed_twin.recap: You announced you were Bunny's long-lost twin.

wired.recap: You wore a wire to dinner.

wine_thrown.recap: You poured wine on Bunny's head.

souffle_incident.recap: You fainted face-first into the souffle.

goat_accused.recap: You accused the goat of being the real twin.

goat_is_family.recap: You toasted the goat as family.

cake_duel.recap: You accepted Bunny's knife and cut the cake.

start.place: VILLA SPARKLE · DOLLY'S DINNER PARTY · 8:42 PM
start.narration: The chandelier is shaking. Not from the bass. From Dolly's laugh. You have been a housewife for exactly eleven minutes.
start.speaker: DOLLY MARCHETTI-WYNN
start.line: Darling, the seating chart is sacred, and you are sitting in Bunny's emotional support chair. Explain yourself before the souffle does.
start.confessional: I don't hold grudges. I hold ledgers. Leather-bound ones. With a ribbon.
memory: Dolly knows you arrived by jet ski.

choices.text: Announce you are Bunny's long-lost twin and demand half the souffle.
Drop to one knee and propose to the chandelier to change the subject.
Calmly reveal you are wearing a wire. It's for a podcast about gluten.

1.narration: The chandelier tinkles softly. Dolly's laugh is warm, like a candle that has opinions. You have been a housewife for eleven minutes.
1.line: Oh sweetheart, that's Bunny's special chair. Would you mind sliding over, gently, like a cloud?
1.confessional: I'm not upset. I'm simply keeping a very polite list.

3.narration: The chandelier is shaking. Dolly's fourth Pinot has entered the chat. You have been a housewife for eleven minutes and you have already ruined her whole life.
3.line: You absolute [BLEEP]. You sat in Bunny's chair. I've buried people for less, and I wasn't even angry then.
3.confessional: I'm going to ruin her. Socially, financially, and then in whatever way is left. I have a spreadsheet.

choices.text: Announce you're Bunny's long-lost twin and demand half the souffle AND half her husband.
Drop to one knee and propose to the chandelier. Use the ring Dolly lost in 2019.
Calmly reveal the wire. The podcast is called 'Dolly's Debts.'

twin.place: VILLA SPARKLE · THE DINING ROOM · 8:44 PM
twin.narration: Bunny rises. Her pearls rise one second later, out of respect.
twin.speaker: BUNNY VANDERKLEET
twin.line: A twin? I was an only child. I made sure of it. Which of our parents told you this, and did they sign anything?
twin.confessional: If she's my twin, where's my half of the inheritance? And the nice half of her I didn't get?
memory: Bunny now suspects you of being family.

choices.text: Pour your wine on Bunny's head. It's how twins are tested.
Faint, face-first, into the souffle.
Accuse the goat of being the real twin.

wined.place: VILLA SPARKLE · THE DINING ROOM · 8:46 PM
wined.narration: A single glass of Merlot travels in a perfect arc. It lands exactly where you aimed. The room gasps in a key you didn't know existed.
wined.speaker: BUNNY VANDERKLEET
wined.line: Is this... Merlot? I can't decide whether to scream or ask for the vintage.
wined.confessional: Fine. It was a good year. But she doesn't get the souffle AND the Merlot.
memory: Bunny is dripping, and taking names.

choices.text: Hand her a napkin and call it a baptism.
Pour the rest on Dolly, to be fair.
Ask if she'd like a second coat.

1.narration: A tiny splash of Merlot lands very gently. Everyone politely pretends not to notice.
1.line: Oh! That's a little damp. Does anyone have a napkin? No rush.
1.confessional: Accidents happen. But I will remember the vintage.

3.narration: A glass of Merlot travels in a perfect arc and lands like a baptism. The sommelier crosses himself.
3.line: Is that the 2019?! You absolute animal. That was four hundred dollars a bottle, you [BLEEP].
3.confessional: I'm not mad about the wine. I'm mad it looks good on me.

souffle.place: VILLA SPARKLE · THE DINING TABLE · 8:46 PM
souffle.narration: You land in the souffle with the grace of a falling piano. The souffle, in turn, lands on Dolly.
souffle.speaker: DOLLY MARCHETTI-WYNN
souffle.line: You fainted into my souffle. It's still warm. So is my fury.
souffle.confessional: Four hours that souffle took. And she wears it like a facial.
memory: Dolly is plating you for the guests.

choices.text: Wake up and claim it was a spa treatment.
Stay perfectly still and hope the goat takes the blame.
Eat your way out, slowly, maintaining eye contact.

goat.place: VILLA SPARKLE · THE DINING ROOM · 8:46 PM
goat.narration: The goat, silent until now, steps up to the emotional support chair and sits. A second later, something strange happens to Bunny's head.
goat.speaker: BUNNY VANDERKLEET
goat.line: Oh my God. The horns. It's genetic. Why did nobody tell me?
goat.confessional: All those years of headbutting my own reflection finally make sense.
memory: Bunny believes she is part goat.

choices.text: Welcome her to the herd.
Confirm the family resemblance with a DNA test.
Offer her a tin can, as a family tradition.

chandelier.place: VILLA SPARKLE · UNDER THE CHANDELIER · 8:44 PM
chandelier.narration: The chandelier does not answer. A sommelier in the corner quietly takes notes.
chandelier.speaker: TAMSIN RUIZ
chandelier.line: Did she just propose to a light fixture? Honestly, bold. But that chandelier has been seeing someone. I'm just saying.
chandelier.confessional: I know who the chandelier is dating. I'm not saying it's the goat. It's the goat.
memory: Tamsin is now your ally, or your witness.

choices.text: Demand to know the name of the other fixture.
Throw your wine at the sommelier, as a distraction.
Marry the chandelier, right now, with Tamsin officiating.

wire.place: VILLA SPARKLE · THE DINING ROOM · 8:45 PM
wire.narration: A hush falls. Somewhere, a violin loses its nerve.
wire.speaker: DOLLY MARCHETTI-WYNN
wire.line: A wire? For a podcast? Is it the one with the woman who reviews doorknobs? Because I have notes, and I was in the pilot.
wire.confessional: I will not be recorded without my good side, and my good side is currently in Milan.
memory: Dolly wants a cut of the podcast.

choices.text: Confess the podcast is a front, and the real front is the goat.
Offer Dolly a guest spot if she hands over her ledgers.
Swallow the microphone. Calmly. Maintain eye contact.

dessert.narration: Dessert arrives under a silver dome. Nobody ordered it. The goat is already sitting in front of it.
dessert.speaker: TAMSIN RUIZ
dessert.line: Whoever ordered the flambe, I want you to know I've called a lawyer and a priest, in that order.
dessert.confessional: Eleven of these dinners, and this is the first cake with a knife standing up in it.

use.speaker: BUNNY VANDERKLEET
use.line: Oh look, cake. Why don't you cut it, darling? I insist. I've had some time to think, and I brought my own knife.
use.confessional: Revenge is a dish best served flambeed.
memory: Bunny has been waiting for this moment.

choices.text: Accept the knife and cut the cake with ceremony.
Light the flambe with a sparkler from your purse.
Propose a toast to the goat.
Quietly leave through the window. Take the cake.

revenge_cake.place: VILLA SPARKLE · THE DINING TABLE · 9:20 PM
revenge_cake.narration: You cut the cake with ceremony. Inside, a tiny gold envelope. Bunny has been smiling for a full forty seconds.
revenge_cake.speaker: BUNNY VANDERKLEET
revenge_cake.line: Surprise, darling. I own forty percent of the goat. And the goat has opinions about you.
revenge_cake.confessional: Never throw Merlot at a woman with a trust fund and a livestock portfolio.
memory: Bunny owns forty percent of the goat.

choices.text: Eat the cake, the knife, and the evidence.
Offer Bunny a co-hosting deal on the spot.
Hand the goat the deed and walk away slowly.

endings.title: Your Own Candle Line
endings.text: The network wants a scent called 'Souffle Fury.' Dolly demands royalties and a lifetime supply.

1.title: Your Own Tea Collection
1.text: A tasteful range of calming teas, including 'Seating Chart Serenity.' Dolly approves, mostly.

3.title: Your Own Line of Personal Massagers
3.text: The network has greenlit 'The Sparkle Collection.' It comes in six colors and one deeply awkward product launch. Dolly is asking for royalties.

endings.title: The Spin-Off
endings.text: 'Housewife in the City' premieres in the spring. Six episodes, one goat, no refunds.

3.text: 'Housewife in the City' premieres in the spring. The network is calling it 'a lot.' Legal is calling it other things.

endings.title: One More Season
endings.text: Renewed, with a probationary peach. The goat has been added to the credits.

endings.title: Woman Near Fountain
endings.text: You get one minute of screen time. You are holding a fountain. The goat gets a better edit.

3.text: You get one minute of screen time. You are holding a fountain and a restraining order. The goat gets a better edit.
